name: ILLBot
description: The ultimate Geometry Dash botting suite for Impossible Levels (ILL), featuring Silicate-styled GUI, independent P1/P2 Autoclickers, TPS Changer, Replay Macro, Trajectory and Hitboxes.

p1-cps.name: P1 CPS (Clicks Per Second)
p1-cps.description: Clicks per second for Player 1 (from 1 to 2000 CPS).

p1-hold-mode.name: P1 Hold Mode
p1-hold-mode.description: If enabled, P1 only autoclicks while holding click/key. If disabled, spams continuously.

p2-hold-mode.name: P2 Hold Mode
p2-hold-mode.description: If enabled, P2 only autoclicks while holding Player 2 input.

tps-enabled.name: TPS Bypass / Changer
tps-enabled.description: Enable custom physics ticks per second (TPS).

speedhack-value.name: Game Speed Multiplier
speedhack-value.description: Speedhack multiplier (e.g. 0.25x for building/botting, 1.0x for normal).

show-trajectory.name: Show Trajectory
show-trajectory.description: Show forward flight/jump trajectory with hazard collision and death marker.

show-hitboxes.name: Show Hitboxes
show-hitboxes.description: Show hitboxes for player, solids, and hazards.

safe-mode.name: Safe Mode
safe-mode.description: Prevent submitting scores to online leaderboards when cheats are active.
